sections.heading: Anushka Sharma — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Anushka Sharma was born on 1 May 1988 in Ayodhya, and holds Indian nationality.
Public records name her father, Ajay Kumar Sharma and her mother, Ashima Sharma. She is a sibling of Karnesh Sharma.
She studied at Anna University Chennai – Regional Office, Tiruchirappalli and Bangalore University.
She is recorded as speaking Hindi.
